content.text:
I fixed the layout. Both visual snapshots (desktop and phone) now match their approved baselines, so I didn't change or approve any baselines.

Two values in `site/css/styles.css` didn't match stock Bootstrap:
- **`.container`:** `width` was `150%`, so the page overflowed horizontally. On the phone the capture was 585px wide instead of 390px. I set it back to `100%`.
- **`.lead`:** `font-size` was `1.875rem`, which made the subtitle too large. I set it back to `1.25rem`.

I didn't look for the commit that introduced these two values. The repo only has the initial commit.

STATUS: DONE
